chapter_title: The Chapter of the Man who asks: Why [am] I sometimes at peace, and troubled at other times?
chapter_note: The chapter is built as a framed Q&A. The opening and closing are hagiographic frame; the disciple’s long self-description includes institutional piety (fasting, psalms, prayers) and reads as later pastoral coloration. The oldest teaching substrate is concentrated in the explanatory mechanism: purification by the Light Mind, disturbances via birth-signs/stars and the ‘roots/conduits’ of the heavenly powers, and the mixed composition of food and drink affecting inner states—plus the notable doctrine of ‘justified souls’ present in nourishment (transmigration/merit language).

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic dialogue frame (‘Once again… I beseech you, my master’).
First-person rhetorical setup inside the Q&A frame; experiential piety and self-report, not impersonal cosmological mechanism.
Continuation of the disciple’s self-report (confusion, passions, social impact ‘for my brothers’). Application/psychological rhetoric rather than structural cosmological exposition.
Institutional devotional practice vocabulary (fasting, praying, psalms) and moral/social comportment (‘indulgent to my brothers’) mark later church-life application rather than substrate teaching.
Beseeching request formula concluding the question; hagiographic frame voice.

paragraphs.core_text: The soul that assumes the body, when the Light Mind will come to it, shall be purified by the power of wisdom and obedience, and it is cleansed and made a new man. There is no trouble in (the soul), nor confusion nor disturbance.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution and exhortative frame: ‘Then the apostle speaks… Well do you ask… Behold, I will explain it to you! Understand this:’ (Layer-2 compilation frame; ‘apostle’ marker).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core teaching begins with impersonal cosmological mechanism (Light Mind purifies; ‘new man’; state-change description). The surrounding speaker-attribution is later frame.

paragraphs.core_text: However, when a disturbance will arise for him and he will be troubled, this disturbance shall go into him in [ ... ], first through his birth-signs and his difficult stars that [ ... ] they turn over him and stir him and trouble him with lust and anger and depression and grief, as he wills. Also, as he wills, the powers of heaven shall trouble him through their roots, to which he is attached.
paragraphs.temporal_note: System-internal causality: astral configuration (‘birth-signs’, ‘difficult stars’) and ‘powers of heaven’ acting through ‘roots’—a structural cosmological explanation rather than exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, there are times you shall find the powers of heaven are peaceful and tranquil for him, and it comes to [ ... ] a difficult part comes into him by the nourishment that he has eaten, or else indeed in some [ ... ] or in the water that they have drunk. Again, trouble and confusion and anger will increase in him, and lust multiplies upon him together with depression and grief; because of the nourishment of the bread he has eaten and the water he has drunk, which are full of bothersome parts, a vengeful counsel. They shall enter his body, [mixed in] with these foods, and they even become joined in with the wicked parts of the body and the sin that is in him; transferring the anger and the lust and the depression and the grief, these wicked thoughts of the body.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmos→cosmos/material mechanism: food/water as mixed carriers of ‘parts’ that join to bodily wicked parts, transferring passions; no institutional targeting despite second-person phrasing.

paragraphs.core_text: that should you be troubled [ ... ... ] them through the conduits and the roots of they above [ ... ... ] the flood that comes into you.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed editorial/teacher meta-introduction: ‘Now, behold, I have explained to you…’ (dialogical recap voice).
paragraphs.temporal_note: The remaining fragment preserves technical causal terms (‘conduits’, ‘roots’, ‘flood’ as influx), but the recap formula indicates later compilation voice layered over it.

paragraphs.core_text: There are times, however, if you shall find that the nourishment that comes into you is pure [ ... ... ], so it is greater in light and life while the waste is less in it, and the evil-doing is diminished from it. Even the atmosphere above is still, being purified through the [ ... ... ] also the image is calmed from [ ... ... ] increases in you through those good parts of the food that come into you. And they find you at ease and tranquil, as you are well governed in your abodes because of the living part, which is greater on account of the light of these justified souls that are in it. The ones that have perfected their deeds. Their dues have ceased, while their soul is carefree [ ... ] they have been allied with these living souls that [are p]resent in you. Due to this you shall find them in you, calm in tranquillity, and they come from you without trouble; and you are found flourishing of body. Even your deeds are determined, being well constructed after their manner, and your doctrines are in order, as your words [ ... ] your soul is carefree within you, ascending like a bird.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Sustained mechanistic exposition: purity of nourishment (light/life vs waste), calm of ‘atmosphere above’/‘image’, and the ‘justified souls’ present in food increasing the living balance—strongly system-internal, though the transmigration/‘dues have ceased’ phrasing may reflect later syncretic development within the teaching tradition.

paragraphs.core_text: When [your bo]dy is troubled, you shall be troubled by the conduits of they below, the difficult parts that come into you by food and the act of eating. Again, when the conduits above are calmed from you, even your food that has come into you is clear and pure. Your heart shall be found ordered in its place, your counsels at peace from disturbance.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogical recap and question-restatement: ‘Behold, I have explained to you the determination of this lesson for which you asked… I have told you that…’ (Layer-2 explanatory frame).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core remainder is a concise two-channel model (conduits below vs conduits above) linking bodily disturbance and food-derived ‘parts’ to inner order—impersonal structural summary embedded in later recap voice.
Formulaic closing doxology/praise of the apostle (‘glorified… You are glorious and blessed’), typical hagiographic frame.
